summary: Master debt collection and credit management with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential tools for success in financial recovery.
lede: Collections training covers assessing customer credit, setting exposure limits and following up on overdue invoices while managing payment conversations. It is designed for credit controllers, accounts receivable teams, analysts and finance managers who need a consistent credit-to-cash process. Learners practise reviewing credit risk and ageing, planning collection calls and payment arrangements, resolving disputes, and using receivables reports to guide escalation.
audienceIntro: This debt collection and credit management training is designed for professionals who handle receivables, credit exposure, overdue accounts, and customer payment follow-up in operational settings.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of basic accounting terms, invoicing, customer accounts, and receivables processes. No programming is required, but familiarity with spreadsheets and financial reports such as ageing schedules, customer ledgers, and collections dashboards will help you move faster. The course assumes you already work with credit decisions, overdue accounts, payment follow-up, or finance reporting, or that you support those processes in a commercial, operations, or finance role.
